brief:
Britain's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced the first sanctions targeting Israeli companies involved in building illegal settlements in the West Bank, according to The Guardian. The measure aims to obstruct further settlement construction, which the Foreign Office says Israel has declined to restrict.

The UK government characterized the move as a response to Israel's inaction on curbing settlement expansion. Officials describe the illegal settlements as a persistent obstacle to peace efforts in the region.

title: Miliband imposes first UK sanctions on Israeli settlement firms
